name: Way of the Stoic Mountain (Combat)
body:
Refusing to budge, you shrug off even deadly attacks with your inner might.

Prerequisite(s): Str 17, Boulder Crushing Palm, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +11, ki pool

Benefit(s): If you spend a ki point as a swift action, you may gain DR/- equal to your Strength modifier for a number of rounds equal to half your Strength modifier. If you are moved by another’s actions, this effect immediately ends.

In addition, you may use the benefit of Boulder Crushing Palm in place of a single regular attack each round made during a full attack action or flurry of blows, declared before the attack roll is made.

Special: This is added to the list of feats that a monk may select as a bonus feat at 10th level and above.
